methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: KPIs are a useful resource to evaluate the technical and economic quality of the projects in the database.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Cross-sector EU-MERCI survey: defines techno-economic KPIs to select energy-efficiency 'Good Practices' and describes a database/online platform. No EnPI/EnB measurement model is identified or characterised (no variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach given); energy-performance indicators appear only as named ranking KPIs - incidental mention in a tool/database paper.

paper_type.evidence_quote: it has been decided to build an online platform that is publicly accessible.

stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility: KPIs (energy intensity reduction, energy consumption improvement) are EnPI-adjacent but not characterised as a model. level_3b independently false: broad cross-sector survey (food, pulp&paper, coke/petroleum, chemicals, glass/ceramic/cement, iron&steel, machinery); closed-list sectors only as examples. paper_type alt: methodological/theoretical.
